C1442.title: Time Tells All: De-anonymization Attack Targeting Blockchain RPC Users
C1442.summary: This academic study presents a novel de-anonymization attack that links blockchain RPC users' IP addresses to their on-chain pseudonymous addresses. The attack requires no transaction fees and does not assume an active network eavesdropper; it works solely by analyzing metadata such as the timing of RPC requests.
